surrogate.selection: Within each original split, randomly select 3% of source records stratified by record window count; retain all windows and ARI 0-9

jlu.selection: Highest participant mean same-window Pearson correlation on samples 11:100 under the five frozen MS-aux models; average seeds, windows within side, then sides; lower variance-normalized MSE breaks ties. Repeated-visit participant omitted for a single-record demo.
jlu.interpretation: Curated favorable illustrations; not an unbiased evaluation cohort or an AUC estimate.

units: ABP and CBFV are dimensionless relative perturbations; step is in training-standardized output/input units
